In [[geometry]], the '''Miquel configuration''' is a [[Configuration (geometry)|configuration]] of eight [[Point (geometry)|points]] and six [[circle]]s in the [[Euclidean plane]], (8<sub>3</sub> 6<sub>4</sub>), with four points per circle and three circles through each point.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Grünbaum | first = Branko | authorlink = Branko Grünbaum
 | isbn = 978-0-8218-4308-6
 | location = Providence, RI
 | mr = 2510707
 | page = xiv+399
 | publisher = American Mathematical Society
 | series = [[Graduate Studies in Mathematics]]
 | title = Configurations of points and lines
 | volume = 103
 | year = 2009}}.</ref>

== In two dimensions ==
Its [[Levi graph]] is the [[rhombic dodecahedral graph]], the skeleton of the [[rhombic dodecahedron]]. The configuration is related to [[Miquel's theorem]].

File:Miquel configuration-4-fold.png|The configuration drawn with square symmetry

== In three dimensions==
The configuration has maximal symmetry in 3-dimension, and can be seen as 6 circles circumscribe the square faces of a [[cube]]. It has 12 sets of pairwise circle intersections, corresponding to the edges of the cube and octahedron. Structurally it has 48 automorphisms of [[octahedral symmetry]].

If two opposite circles are removed the configuration becomes (8<sub>2</sub> 4<sub>2</sub>), with 128 automorphisms (4 rotations by 2<sup>3</sup> pair interchanges)

A different (8<sub>3</sub> 6<sub>4</sub>) can be found as with 6 central circles on a cube. The circles are on the 6 mirror planes of [[tetrahedral symmetry]]. In full it has 384 automorphisms of [[hyperoctahedral symmetry]] as the maximal geometric symmetry can be seen in 6, [[Combination|C(4,2)]], orthogonal circles as central squares in a [[16-cell]].

== Dual configuration==

The dual configuration (6<sub>4</sub> 8<sub>3</sub>) can be drawn with the 6 vertices of an [[octahedron]] and the 8 circles circumscribe the 8 triangular faces. 

Taking half of the circles makes (6<sub>2</sub> 4<sub>3</sub>) with [[tetrahedral symmetry]] and 24 automorphisms. This is isomorphic to the point-line configuration [[Complete_quadrangle|complete quadrilateral]].

Three central circles can also go through the same 6 vertices, and can be seen as square faces in the [[tetrahemihexahedron]].
